The Apple Mac Pro M2 Ultra Tower Desktop PC is a powerhouse built for creative professionals who need top-tier performance. Powered by the incredible M2 Ultra chip with a 24-core CPU (16 performance cores and 8 efficiency cores), this Mac Pro tackles even the most demanding tasks like video editing, 3D rendering, and complex simulations with ease. Its 76-core GPU and 64GB of unified RAM deliver blazing-fast performance with 800 GB/s memory bandwidth—equivalent to seven Afterburner cards! The M2 Ultra’s media engine can handle up to 22 streams of 8K ProRes video, and the 1TB SSD ensures lightning-fast boot and load times.

This Mac Pro is designed for flexibility, offering six PCIe Gen 4.0 slots (two x16 and four x8) for easy upgrades, plus a PCIe 3.0 x4 slot for the Apple I/O card. Connectivity is a breeze with eight Thunderbolt 4 ports (40 Gb/s with DisplayPort support), two HDMI ports for 8K at 240 Hz, two USB-A ports, a 3.5 mm audio jack, dual 10 Gigabit Ethernet LAN jacks, Wi-Fi 6E, and Bluetooth 5.3. Its unified design means you can tap into its full power without rewriting any code.

The Apple I/O card slots into a half-length PCIe 3.0 x4 slot, keeping things versatile.

Packed with High-Performance I/O

Stay connected with eight Thunderbolt 4 ports for super-fast data transfer, two HDMI ports for 8K displays, two USB-A ports for legacy devices, and a 3.5 mm audio jack. Imou Cruiser 4G Dome IP Camera in Bangladesh

 

Welcome to TBZ Engineering’s collection of smart surveillance — introducing the Imou Cruiser 4G Dome IP Camera, an ideal security companion for areas where Wi-Fi is not available. With 4G SIM connectivity and advanced surveillance features, this dome IP camera ensures real-time monitoring anytime, anywhere.This model is specially designed for outdoor environments, combining weatherproof construction, 360-degree viewing, and full-color night vision for round-the-clock security. Whether it's a farmhouse, construction site, remote shop, or warehouse — the Cruiser 4G offers stable performance and real-time alerts directly to your phone over mobile networks.

Key Features & Benefits

Full 360-degree Pan & Tilt View ensures you cover every corner of the monitored area without blind spots

Built-in 4G SIM Support makes it independent of Wi-Fi networks — ideal for remote locations or mobile setups

2MP or 4MP Resolution provides crystal-clear video quality both day and night

Full-Color Night Vision uses smart LED floodlights to deliver color footage in darkness, unlike regular IR

AI Human Detection reduces false alarms by intelligently identifying human movement and ignoring pets or tree motion

Weatherproof IP66 Rating makes it suitable for rain, heat, or dusty conditions

Two-Way Audio lets you hear and talk directly through the camera using your smartphone

Cloud & Local Storage support gives you the option to store footage on SD card or Imou Cloud for backup

Smart Motion Alerts instantly notify you via app when movement is detected

Remote Access via Imou Life App allows live viewing, playback, and customization of alerts from anywhere

Popular Use Cases

The Imou Cruiser 4G Dome Camera is widely used for remote farm monitoring, vehicle storage yards, under-construction sites, street-side shops, security cabins, or places with no stable internet. It works effectively using any local 4G SIM.

Availability & Support

Frequently Asked Questions

What is the main difference between Imou Cruiser 4G and Wi-Fi models?
The Cruiser 4G uses a mobile SIM for internet instead of depending on Wi-Fi, making it perfect for remote areas.

Can I use this camera at a location without electricity?
Yes, you can pair it with solar power or UPS backup, but the camera itself requires 12V DC power input.

Does the camera work at night?
Yes. It has full-color night vision using LEDs and also supports infrared mode.

Is there any monthly charge?
Only your mobile data cost from the SIM provider. The camera app and usage are free.

Can it be accessed from multiple phones?
Yes. You can share access through the Imou Life app.

Final Words

The Imou Cruiser 4G Dome IP Camera is one of the smartest outdoor surveillance solutions for off-grid or unstable internet areas. At TBZ Engineering, we ensure you receive original products with proper installation guidance, technical support, and competitive pricing in Bangladesh.

Intel Core i3 6th Generation Processor in Bangladesh

 

Welcome to TBZ Engineering — your trusted source for authentic processors in Bangladesh. The Intel Core i3 6th Generation is a dependable option for users seeking stable performance for everyday tasks, office work, and moderate multimedia usage. Designed with a balance of speed and efficiency, this processor is an ideal entry-level solution for both desktop upgrades and new system builds.The Intel Core i3 6th Gen offers robust integrated graphics support and power-efficient architecture, making it a cost-effective solution without compromising reliability.

Graphics Features

This processor includes built-in Intel HD Graphics that deliver a base frequency of 350 MHz and can dynamically boost up to 1.05 GHz, ensuring smooth video playback and enhanced visual performance. The processor supports graphics output via eDP, DisplayPort, HDMI, and DVI. It can drive up to three displays simultaneously and supports 4K resolution at 60Hz. Maximum supported resolution via HDMI and DP is 4096 x 2304 pixels. Additionally, it comes equipped with Intel Quick Sync Video, Intel InTru 3D, and Intel Clear Video HD technologies to enhance video rendering and visual quality.

Expansion Options and PCI Express Support

The Intel Core i3 6th Generation supports only 1S scalability. This processor incorporates Intel’s AES New Instructions for advanced encryption, Secure Key for hardware-based random number generation, and Software Guard Extensions with Intel ME for memory isolation and protection. Transform your classroom or training room with the iBoard TE-QS-65 65-Inch 4K UHD Interactive Smart Display, a cutting-edge interactive flat panel display designed for modern education and collaboration. Perfect for schools, institutions, and meeting spaces in Bangladesh, this smart display combines stunning 4K UHD visuals, advanced multi-touch technology, and seamless connectivity to create engaging and interactive learning experiences.

Why Choose the iBoard TE-QS-65 Interactive Smart Display?

Stunning 4K UHD Visuals: The 65-inch D-LED display with 3840 x 2160 resolution delivers vibrant colors and sharp clarity, ideal for classroom presentations and training sessions.

Wide Viewing Angle & Bright Display: With 400 cd/㎡ brightness and a 178° viewing angle, every student enjoys clear visuals from any seat in the room.

Advanced Whiteboard Software: Drawview X and Drawview 6 support Android and Windows, enhancing lesson delivery with powerful annotation tools.

Sleek & Functional Design: The narrow bezel and landscape orientation make it perfect for modern classrooms and meeting rooms, with remote device management for easy control.

Complete Accessory Package: Includes writing pens, remote control, HDMI and USB cables, and a wall mount, with optional mobile stand and VGA/audio cables available.
